notes.title: Card Updates Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The time has come! Now that we have the Card Resummon feature in game, we are able to do a balance pass to bring some older cards up to date. Be aware that this is not all the buffs that we plan to do, this is simply our first wave. So if you see a favorite card that we missed feel free to bring it up in a reply below, but don’t get mad at us (yet)! 

These buffs will go [b]live on Monday, March 13[/b], after the end of the Guild War event. In addition, starting tomorrow and until Monday, March 27, the listed Epic and Legendary cards will be available in the Card Resummon feature at the price that they were vaporized for! That means that you can get unfused Epics on this list back for 30 Arcane Dust instead of 60, and Legendary cards back for 60 instead of 120!

[url=http://www.kongregate.com/pages/spellstone-card-updates-march-2017]View the full list of card updates here![/url]

We do plan to do more waves of buffs in the future, but we haven’t determined when yet.

Thank you for playing Spellstone, we hope you enjoy this update!

notes.title: Guild War Updates
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Exciting news to share with you today! As you may have guessed from the title, we made some exciting changes to the upcoming Guild War.

[b]Overview[/b]
Guild Wars are being changed from 5 day events to 4 day events. The first day will be a Guild War Placement event. This will be a Guild Clash style event with the end rankings being the starting rank for your Guild War matches. The next three days of the event will be Guild Wars as normal, but with much tighter matchmaking that is helped along by the Placement Guild Clash. Final ranking in the event will be based on Victory Points that are earned at the end of each war based on your ranking at the end of the war. This makes the war similar to a “King of the Hill” style event where the longer you stay on top the more points you accumulate.

[b]Guild War Placement [1 Day][/b]
So what is the placement event exactly? Guild War Placements are a Guild Clash style event where guild members earn stars for their guild. These will work identical to a Guild Clash except for a few key differences.[list][*]The event lasts 24 hours.[/*][*]All players start with 30 battles.[/*][*]Battles do not recharge over time.</li[*]You will face tougher opponents earlier on.[/*][/list]
At the end of this 24 hour event, the rankings will determine your starting Matching Points in the Guild War. It is important that you do well in the Guild Clash because you will begin earning Victory Points right away in the Guild War, explained in more detail below.

The goal of the Placement event is to quickly get guilds into reasonably accurate Matching positions, skipping the early matchmaking that previous wars had which lead to a lot of very one-sided matches.

[b]Guild War [3 Days][/b]
The mechanics of the individual matches are going to be the same as they are now. Two guilds are matched for an 8 hour war where they attack each other for dominance in points. Our matchmaking is going to be much tighter than it has been in the past though, as our goal is to deliver meaningful high intensity battles for every match. First place will fight second place, third place will fight fourth place, etc. We’ve also reduced the length of the main War period from 5 days to 3 days, meaning that instead of a total of 15 battles you only get 9. This is offset by the fact that all 9 of these matches will be important for your guild, where in the past the first few days of the event were a slow climb with many wars being extremely one sided.

So here are some of the key differences for the 3 day Guild War:
[list][*]3 Days (9 Battles) instead of 5 Days (15 Battles)[/*][*]Tight Matchmaking. 1st place always plays 2nd place, 3rd vs. 4th, etc.[/*][*]Removed the limitations on guilds having the same matches in a short period of time.[/*][*]Players will no longer face the same enemy deck more than once within one match unless the enemy guild has less than 10 members.[/*][/list]
At the end of each match your new ranking will be calculated and your guild will earn a number of Victory Points based on your new Matching Ranking. At the end of the Guild War event rewards will be given based on your Victory Points and NOT your final standings for matchmaking.

[b]What are Victory Points?[/b]Victory Points are a new way to rank guilds. At the end of each match, guilds gain Victory Points based on their new standings. The higher your rank, the more Victory Points your guild gains. This means the longer you stay at a higher rank, the more Points you will earn and the better your final ranking.

The old point system that determined both matchmaking and ranking still exists and is still used to determine matchmaking. These points are now known as Matching Points.

[b]Why Victory Points instead of Ranking?[/b]
We felt that there was a lot of importance put on the final days of the event where a guild could be knocked down multiple rankings in the final war when they had been on average much higher for the majority of the event. We felt that this was an inaccurate way to rank guilds, and we wanted a system that would reward guilds for doing well throughout the entire event and not just on the last day or two.

notes.title: New Campaign Update
notes.content:
The new Campaigns will have content released every 2 weeks, for a total of 8 weeks. They will be a permanent addition to Spellstone, but expedition rewards will only be earned in a 4 week cycle. A total of two Expeditions will occur on the same Campaign map. The Expedition item, Mist Pearl, can also be used to purchase upgrades for an upcoming new BGE, which will only be activated on the new Campaign map. Now you can customize your own personal battle ground effect! The upgradable BGE feature should be made available in the next few days.

There will be a key item for an Epic card that can be upgraded to a Mythic. It will be available halfway through the event, starting in week 3. You can earn this item in a boss node that will be similar to the Titan nodes. The Mythic will be available to be upgraded like Narix, however instead of Embersouls you will need Brinesouls. You can collect Brinesouls from the Campaign missions. In the future we will be releasing quad Legendary cards in place of the Mythic card, but we wanted to celebrate the new campaign with a more impressive reward.
